entry.title: Welle 0.3.1
entry.summary: Welle 0.3.1: your favourites now survive an upgrade. **Fixed** - **Favourites are kept when you update.** The installer now lists `Content/favourites.txt` as your data, next to your Wave OS files and sound sets, so installing a new version (with the OpenMPC Plugin Manager or `install.sh`) keeps your favourites. entry.title: Welle 0.3.0
entry.summary: Welle 0.3.0: new DISKS page features, plus the +FAV naming keyboard. **New** - **RANDOM** on the DISKS page: loads a random disk, then a random performance on it. - **Disk readout with < > steppers** at the top of the Disks panel, like the performance one; the disk list now has 11 tiles per page, lined up with the performance grid. - The selected disk and performance tiles stay lit. - **+FAV opens a drawn naming keyboard** (SHIFT, DEL, SPACE, CANCEL, SAVE; up to 20 characters, shown beside the n
